lab mcp <command>

## lab mcp setup

```text
Install the pinned mcpjungle CLI (checksum checked), create the admin once, register every tool server in
hub/mcp/servers/*.json, keep only the tools in <name>.tools, and recreate every agent login in
hub/mcp/clients/*.json (tokens from hub/.env, never printed). Safe to run again; agents lose their login for
a few seconds while it is recreated.
Good result: a line per tool server and per client, no FAILED; then `lab mcp status` says "Matches the repo".
```

Usage:

```
lab mcp setup [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   show, change nothing
```

## lab mcp status

```text
One read-only screen of the MCP gateway: registered tool servers (enabled / total tools), which agent may
use which server, and any difference from the repo (hub/mcp/clients/*.json, hub/mcp/servers/*.tools).
No secrets are read or printed. Exit 1 when the gateway differs from the repo.
Good result: "Matches the repo" and every server with at least one tool enabled.
```

Usage:

```
lab mcp status [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --json    one JSON object (for agents)
      --tools   list every tool, on and off
```
